subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should this intermediate shadow integration land with its changed-corpus refresh cost, or only together with the later bounding and performance slices?
rationale: The patch is functionally contained and leaves legacy totals authoritative, but it intentionally puts extra lineage work on production refreshes before later stack slices supply their strongest bounding and optimization controls.

options.title: Require exact-head proof
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted exact-head cold, changed-corpus, unchanged-corpus, and cancellation output demonstrates acceptable refresh latency.

options.title: Merge stack together
options.body: Review and land the dependency chain consecutively so the intermediate runtime profile is never shipped without the later safety and performance controls.

options.title: Accept intermediate cost
options.body: Merge after the foundation with an explicit decision that changed histories may temporarily incur an additional bounded parsing pass.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted exact-head cold, changed-corpus, unchanged-corpus, and cancellation output demonstrates acceptable refresh latency.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete made and validated the current scanner's containment tradeoffs and is the strongest history-backed owner for accepting the next production refresh cost.
